title: API and boundaries
prompt: Checkout service calls Inventory, Payments, and Email inline in one request with no idempotency keys. Client retries on timeout. What do you change first?

choices.label: Add idempotency keys on Payment create; consider async Email
choices.consequence: Retries will otherwise double-charge; email can leave the request path.

choices.label: Remove inventory checks to go faster
Tell clients never to retry
choices.consequence: Networks fail; clients will retry anyway.
